criteria.requirement: Fix actual MarkdownIt.enable/disable to fully materialize a nonstring Iterable once before dispatching names across all parser rule chains and missed-name detection. List/tuple/generator/one-shot iterators must produce identical active sets and rendering; unknown generator names still raise unless ignoreInvalid. If iteration itself raises after yielding a name, no rule chain may already be mutated. Preserve string, duplicate-name, empty input and existing rule-manager semantics; do not add pretend rules or special-case table alone.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。
